fact: On 29 January 2025 the DTS/FO project coordinator told the steering committee that all fibre sections of the 1,031 km Niger component were almost complete and ready for acceptance, with only the data centre late.
title: Ouverture de la 2è réunion du comité de pilotage du projet DTS/FO : Le point sur l'état d'avancement des travaux, des difficultés rencontrées et des solutions envisagées
